# [CS043] Gob Decoding of Untrusted Input (unsafe-gob-decode)

encoding/gob decodes a request body.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-502](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/502.html) |
| **OWASP** | A08:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

gob is meant for trusted peers; crafted streams can allocate excessively or panic the decoder. Use JSON or protobuf with size limits for client data.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
err := gob.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&msg)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
err := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1<<20)).Decode(&msg)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [unsafe-gob-decode]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    unsafe-gob-decode: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore unsafe-gob-decode -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** unsafe-gob-decode
```
